items.item_text: Occupational Therapist license issued by the state of California.
BART or BLS at time of hire with commitment to get BART within six (6) months of hire date.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
May flex and float between sites as needed.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Two (2+) or more years of relevant experience.
Outpatient experience in a hospital-based setting and/or experience in a large academic medical center.

Seeking an Occupational Therapist, experienced in Lymphedema Therapy, to work in our 8,000 square ft. state of the art facility, equipped with indoor and outdoor treatment areas, assistive technology, including InBody 770 and Lymphatouch unit. The Koman Family Outpatient Pavilion is designed specifically to promote ease of collaboration with our world class physicians. Join the region’s only academic medical center and work towards our mission of delivering outstanding patient care through commitment to the community, groundbreaking research and inspired teaching.

This position is responsible for delivery of occupational therapy services including evaluation and treatment of routine and complex patients with lymphedema diagnoses. Responsibilities will also include representing our dynamic Rehabilitation Services department to the medical and general community, demonstrating competence in the UC San Diego Health core values, and sharing your expertise with departmental staff in areas of advanced clinical care and customer service.
Graduation from an accredited school of Occupational Therapy approved by the American Medical Association and the American Occupational Therapy Association.
